plan.title: Skill auto-discovery residual: multi-host thin skill discovery deposit (#75)

narratives.Description: Residual #75 only: deposit thin skill discovery pointers into additional host paths (.claude/skills, .codex/skills, .github/skills, .cursor/skills as needed) mirroring the inventory already under .agents/skills. Core .agents/skills auto-discovery has landed — do not re-implement #94. Coordinate multi-host policy with #55 patterns but do NOT implement slash/command files.
narratives.UserStory: As a multi-host Directive user, I want thin skill discovery entries deposited into host-specific skill directories on init/update, so that agents that do not scan .agents/skills still auto-load the same skill inventory.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Read current shape comment on #75 (2026-08-02) as SoT residual scope.
- Add multi-host skill discovery deposit helper (thin SKILL.md pointers only) for enabled hosts with known layouts.
- Wire into init/update; idempotent rewrite; per-host opt-out; Windows-safe (no elevated symlink requirement).
- Mirror same inventory as .agents/skills (or daily-core tier if policy reuses it).
- Tests: path matrix, non-inlining full skill bodies, opt-out.
- Docs: which hosts get which path; relationship to OpenPackage and #55 slash (different artifact).
- CHANGELOG #75.
- Out: slash files (#55), redoing #94, replacing .agents as canonical.

items.title: Enabled hosts get thin skill discovery deposit

narrative.Acceptance: Given enabled hosts with known skill paths, when init or update runs, then thin discovery SKILL.md (or host-equivalent) entries are deposited for the agreed skill inventory without full skill body copies.
Given additional host paths, when deposit runs, then they mirror the .agents inventory and do not fork independent skill content.
Given Windows without elevated symlinks and a host opt-out, when deposit re-runs, then no elevation is required, opted-out hosts are skipped, and rewrite is idempotent.

items.title: Tests and docs for matrix + #55 relationship

narrative.Acceptance: Given tests and docs, when reviewed, then path matrix and non-inlining are covered and docs distinguish skill discovery (#75) from slash registration (#55).
